package.name: fr_bridge
package.description: Cell-agnostic hardware bridge between MoveIt2 and a real Fairino FR-series robot (+ DH AG-145 gripper) via the Fairino Python SDK. Subscribes to FollowJointTrajectory actions for the arm and gripper, streams to the robot over TCP/IP, publishes /joint_states from real encoders, and exposes a /stop_motion service. Shared by every cell package (unchained, pxrd, ...).
